shots.detail_en: CH stands at the head of the crowd before the still-dark board on the tenth day, eyes closed for three breaths, then open.
shots.sub: 第九根阴线落完的那一夜，我把十年——复盘了三遍。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: MANCANG lines up his floral-shirt legion at the bell and gives his order in a strangled whisper.
shots.sub: 都稳住——今天，一根都别乱碰！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: RED watches from behind the counter as the tide of sell pressure meets layer upon layer of waiting orders and is caught dead at the final price line.
shots.sub: 他接了。九天没动，他在最后那个价位——稳稳接住了。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH raises one hand and slowly closes his palm in the middle of the hall, as if folding up a wind.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH's eyes catch a thin red needle piercing up from the roots of the green wall on the board.
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: CH looks up as a colossal red candle bores through the clouds — the flip-board detonates red from bottom to top and swallows all nine green bars in one night.
shots.sub: 红了！！九根阴线——一口吞了！！
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: MANCANG drops to his knees then springs back up as his legion detonates from dead silence into pandemonium.
shots.sub: 我满仓我骄傲！军团万岁——！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: XIONG's binoculars stop mid-air in the slit of the VIP curtain — the color drains from the face that has never once changed in ten years.
XIONG lowers the binoculars slowly inside the VIP box, staring at the giant red candle on the board below.
shots.sub: 十年了……第一次有人在我的盘上，画了一根我不认识的阳线。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: XIONG dips his fountain pen in red ink and draws a single circle through one line of figures in the open ledger on the table — crossed out.
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI stands before the server-room screen, a waterfall of data pouring across his rimless glasses.
shots.sub: 模型没有输。输的——是您给模型画的边界。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONG closes the ledger in his hands, the red circle bleeding through the paper's back.
shots.sub: 他赢的，是行情。／行情——也是变量。
shots.speaker: 熊天成+熊伟

shots.detail_en: CH stands amid the closing bell as the board burns full red and paper slips rain down over the hall like confetti of an era.
CH stays before the board as the tide of people drains away and leather footsteps descend the grand staircase — XIONG comes down himself for the second time.
XIONG walks straight up to CH and extends his hand first, before the young man can move.
shots.sub: 年轻人——你赢的是行情，不是我。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH looks down at the offered hand, then up into XIONG's eyes without blinking.
shots.sub: 熊先生——行情，不一直是您的『手』吗？
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: XIONG's smile does not move an inch while the first hairline crack surfaces in the depths of his eyes.
shots.sub: 我从来没有做错过任何事——这是我第一次，输给了行情。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH and XIONG's hands clasp at the hall's center — a black suit cuff and a white shirt cuff meeting in one frame.
CH grips back, his gaze as calm as a candlestick drawing its closing needle.
shots.sub: 下次，我赢的——就不只是行情了。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: XIONG studies him for two seconds, then bursts into a warm ringing laugh, withdraws his hand, and pats CH once on the shoulder.
shots.sub: 记住今天这根阳线。总有一天——市场会连本带利，把它收回去。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: CH watches from the red-lit floor as XIONG climbs back up and vanishes behind the VIP curtain, sunset flooding the empty hall.
shots.sub: 爸，第十天——我把他，打回了止损。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH opens the notebook and sketches one small hand-drawn bull candle above the final page's blank line — the missing line still left blank.
Black end-card with white title text handing off to the next battle arc.
